approved_decisions.rule: Server-generated canonical lowercase UUIDv4; immutable per occurrence.
Globally unique instance_id within match; each stable occurrence appears in exactly one zone.
Multiple instances may share card_id; current 12-distinct-model deck builder rule remains unchanged.
exemplar_id references current global cartas_exemplares.id PK; validate row existence, owner/user_id and card_id; never infer or reuse.
Materialized tokens receive instance_id; equipped relic is outside zones; activation is preferably an event/operation; if materialized it receives its own transient instance_id and null exemplar_id.
Use target_instance_id for a single physical target and unique target_instance_ids for multiple targets; legacy adapter resolves only one eligible match.
Persisted zone order defines first/last; metric selectors declare tie-breaker, with zone order then instance_id fallback.
Removal, sacrifice, discard extraction, recovery and resurrection act on exact physical instances, never bulk-match by card_id.
